head: codex/74-stale-claim-topology-regression
title: [v0.92][C-SDLC v2] Prove stale claim records do not block bind
body:
Closes #74

Adds the exact real-binary regression for the stale foreign topology failure: an unrelated legacy issue projection containing the retired claim field is skipped and remains byte-for-byte unchanged. The same retired field on the relevant issue still fails closed, and existing same-issue, branch, and canonical-worktree collision checks remain enforced.

No production code changed because the relevance-first implementation already satisfies the reported behavior.

Validation: cargo fmt; focused Gate 2 csdlc-bind regression 1/1 passed; git diff --check; typed csdlc-validate passed at reviewed generation 9. Independent exact-revision review completed with no findings; broader topology integration remains GitHub CI evidence.
